title: AI for...Scratch?
author: Donkeytonk
selftext:
Any Scratchers here? LLMs can’t generate block code directly so we made a Scratch-based AI Copilot that can. It’s context aware so can answer questions about the project, debug block code, and generate new ideas. It also works on imported Scratch projects. Getting LLM pseudo code to syntax correct blocks was a hard slog for us, but it’s at a point we’re ready to share. Still a lot of things it can't do yet but we think it could be useful for beginners, maybe even more advanced users too. 

What do you think? We’d love to hear your feedback 

[https://stax.fun](https://stax.fun)
